en: A vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a town square with historic buildings and a large castle on a hill in the background. The sky is partly cloudy, and the scene is tranquil, with a few people and horse-drawn carriages visible. The left side of the card is dominated by the photo, while the right side contains handwritten text. The bottom left of the image contains printed text in Italian: 'Piazza grande e il Castello.' At the top right, the word 'Arco' is printed in red, and more handwritten text appears across the right half.
